from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
p=Path('conversation_archive_v1')
a={'initial_messages':json.loads((p/'initial_messages.json').read_text()),'exchanges':[json.loads(f.read_text()) for f in sorted((p/'entries').glob('*.json'))]}
print(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest())
print(len(a['exchanges']))
